       INNER JOIN snd_pr_dot_documenttype PDOT
               ON CMM.porg_orgacode = PDOT.porg_orgacode
                  AND CMM.pdot_docmtype = PDOT.pdot_docmtype

(SELECT CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO                                                                               AS TCLR_RFSRNO,
        CLR.porg_orgacode                                                                             AS porg_orgacode,
        CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE                                                                       AS PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE,
        CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code                                                                 AS epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID                                                                             AS PSCH_SCHME_ID,
        ps.ppms_reference_code                                                                        AS REF_PROMO_CODE,
        coalesce(PS.ppms_desc, PSM.ppms_desc)                                                         AS TXT__PromoDesc,
        CLR.tclr_refdoctype                                                                           AS tclr_refdoctype,
        CLR.tclr_refdocno                                                                             AS tclr_refdocno,
        coalesce(cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,
                 hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c)                                                      AS epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,
        coalesce(lvl1.epp1_desc, offinv.epp1_desc)                                                    AS epp1_desc,
        CLR.TCLM_DOCNO                                                                                AS TCLM_DOCNO,
        CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO                                                                            AS TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
        CLM.modified_date                                                                             AS modified_date,
        CLD.pdot_docmtype                                                                             AS PDOT_DOCMTYPE,

case
            when CLD.pdot_docmtype in ('OIC-01', 'VC')
                then sum(coalesce(hd.tfdh_total_adjusted_amt_bcy, hd.tfdh_amount_fcy))
            when CLD.pdot_docmtype in ('LS-01', 'DC') then SUM(CLD.tcld_grs_amt_fcy)
            else
             CASE
                                                WHEN CLR.tclr_refdoctype IN ('CM-04', 'CM-02') THEN -1
                                                ELSE 1
                                                END *
                abs(coalesce((ROUND(SUM(

                                            CASE
                                                WHEN t.ptrn_nature = 'FRE'
                                                    THEN COALESCE((i.tcmi_claim_amount_fcy), 0)
                                                ELSE
                                                    COALESCE((i.tcmi_dsc_amt_fcy), 0)
                                                END
                                    ), 2) * coalesce(NULLIF(o.tcmo_claimable_perc, 0), 1) / 100))) end AS claimAmountFC,
        STM.TSTM_INVOICE_NO AS TSTM_INVOICE_NO
FROM snd_tr_clm_claim_master CLM
          INNER JOIN snd_tr_cld_claim_detail CLD
                     ON CLD.porg_orgacode = CLM.porg_orgacode AND
                        CLD.pdot_docmtype = CLM.pdot_docmtype AND
                        CLD.pbet_busentity_type = CLM.pbet_busentity_type AND
                        CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                        CLD.tclm_docno = CLM.tclm_docno
          INNER JOIN snd_tr_clr_claim_refinfo CLR
                     ON CLR.porg_orgacode = CLD.porg_orgacode AND
                        CLR.pdot_docmtype = CLD.pdot_docmtype AND
                        CLR.pbet_busentity_type = CLD.pbet_busentity_type AND
                        CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                        CLR.tclm_docno = CLD.tclm_docno and CLR.tcld_serial_no = CLD.tcld_serial_no
          inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                     on CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = dt.PORG_ORGACODE and CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dt.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
          left outer JOIN snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cmm ON CLR.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                                                            CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                            clr.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type AND
                                                            CLR.tclr_refdocno = cmm.tcmm_docno and
                                                            CLR.tclr_refdoctype = cmm.pdot_docmtype

          left outer join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering o
                          on o.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode
                              and o.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type
                              and o.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                              and o.pdot_docmtype = cmm.pdot_docmtype
                              and o.tcmm_docno = cmm.tcmm_docno
                              and coalesce(o.tcmo_claimable, 'N') = 'Y'
                              and o.PSCH_SCHME_ID = CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID

          left outer join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offritem i
                          on o.porg_orgacode = i.porg_orgacode
                              and o.pbet_busentity_type = i.pbet_busentity_type
                              and o.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = i.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                              and o.pdot_docmtype = i.pdot_docmtype
                              and o.tcmm_docno = i.tcmm_docno
                              and o.tcmo_offer_srno = i.tcmo_offer_srno
          LEFT JOIN snd_pr_trn_trans_nature t
                    on t.porg_orgacode = i.porg_orgacode
                        and t.ptrn_tran_nature = i.ptrn_tran_nature
                        and t.ptrn_nature in ('DIS', 'FRE')

          LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 lvl1
                    ON lvl1.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                       lvl1.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND
                       lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c and
                       lvl1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c
          LEFT JOIN glb_pr_bem_busentity_mistype MIS ON MIS.porg_orgacode = lvl1.porg_orgacode AND
                                                        MIS.pbem_busentity_mistype = lvl1.pbem_busentity_mistype
          LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup PS
                    ON CLD.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode AND
                       CLD.psch_schme_id = PS.ppms_promotion_code And
                       CLD.tcmo_promotion_type = PS.pprt_resultant_type
          LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup_m PSM
                    ON PSM.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode AND
                       PSM.ppms_promotion_code = PS.ppms_promotion_code
                        AND PSM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join snd_tr_fdh_financial_doc_hdr hd on
         clr.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode
         and clr.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busentity_type
         and clr.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         and clr.tclr_refdoctype = hd.pdot_docmtype
         and clr.tclr_refdocno = hd.tfdh_docno

          LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 offinv
                    ON offinv.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode and
                       offinv.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND
                       offinv.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c and
                       offinv.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c

LEFT OUTER JOIN snd_tr_stm_stock_master STM
ON STM.porg_orgacode = CLR.porg_orgacode
    AND STM.pbet_busentity_type = CLR.pbet_busentity_type
    AND STM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
    AND STM.pdot_docmtype = CLR.tclr_refdoctype
    AND STM.tstm_docno = CLR.tclr_refdocno

group by CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO, CLR.porg_orgacode, CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE, CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
          CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID, PS.ppms_desc, PSM.ppms_desc, CLR.tclr_refdoctype, CLR.tclr_refdocno,
          cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c, lvl1.epp1_desc, CLR.TCLM_DOCNO, CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO, CLM.modified_date,
          CLD.pdot_docmtype, o.tcmo_claimable_perc,
          hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c, offinv.epp1_desc, ps.ppms_reference_code ,STM.TSTM_INVOICE_NO
)

(SELECT stdds.create_date,
        stdds.porg_orgacode,
        stdds.pbet_busentity_type,
        stdds.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        stdds.tdsl_deposit_slip_srno,
        Concat(stdds.epjp_pjpno_daily, ' - ', PJPHD_M.epjp_desc)                AS PJP_DSR,
        stdds.ppym_paymmode,
        stdds.pbnk_bank_code,
        stdds.pbnb_bnbr_code,
        stdds.tdsl_instrument_type,
        stdds.tdsl_instrument_refno,
        stdds.tdsl_amount_fcy,
        stdds.tdsl_amount_bcy,
        CASE WHEN stdds.tdsl_status IS NULL THEN 'I' ELSE stdds.tdsl_status END AS tdsl_status,
        stdds.epjp_pjpno_daily,
        stdds.tdsl_deposit_slip_date,
        SUM(COALESCE(stddsd.tdsd_amount_fcy, 0))                                AS tdsd_amount_fcy,
        stdds.MODIFIED_DATE                                                     AS MODIFIED_DATE,
        stdds.tdsl_ref_1                                                        AS tdsl_ref_1
 FROM snd_tr_dsl_deposit_slip stdds
          LEFT JOIN snd_tr_dsd_deposit_slip_dtl stddsd ON stddsd.porg_orgacode = stdds.porg_orgacode AND
                                                          stddsd.pbet_busentity_type = stdds.pbet_busentity_type AND
                                                          stddsd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = stdds.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                                                          stddsd.tdsl_deposit_slip_srno = stdds.tdsl_deposit_slip_srno
          LEFT JOIN snd_en_pjp_pjphead_m PJPHD_M ON stdds.porg_orgacode = PJPHD_M.porg_orgacode AND
                                                    stdds.pbet_busentity_type = PJPHD_M.pbet_busentity_type AND
                                                    stdds.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = PJPHD_M.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                                                    stdds.epjp_pjpno_daily = PJPHD_M.epjp_pjpno and
                                                    PJPHD_M.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

 GROUP BY stdds.porg_orgacode,
          stdds.pbet_busentity_type, stdds.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
          stdds.tdsl_deposit_slip_srno, stdds.ppym_paymmode,
          stdds.pbnk_bank_code, stdds.pbnb_bnbr_code,
          stdds.tdsl_instrument_type, stdds.tdsl_instrument_refno,
          stdds.tdsl_amount_fcy, stdds.tdsl_amount_bcy, stdds.tdsl_status,
          stdds.create_date, stdds.created_by, stdds.modified_by,
          stdds.modified_by, stdds.epjp_pjpno_daily,
          stdds.tdsl_deposit_slip_date, PJPHD_M.epjp_desc
          )

(SELECT cm.porg_orgacode                    AS Orgacode,
        cm.pbet_busentity_type              AS distributortype,
        cm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code        AS distributorcode,
        cm.pdot_docmtype                    AS docmtype,
        cm.tcmm_docno                       AS docno,
        cm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c      AS outletcode,
        lvl1m.epp1_desc                     AS outletname,
        cm.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l      AS section,
        CAST(cm.tcmm_docm_date AS DATE)     AS docmdate,
        CAST(cm.TCMM_DELIVERY_DATE as date) AS delivdate,
        cd.tcmd_qty_1                       AS carton,
        cd.tcmd_qty_2                       AS dozen,
        cd.tcmd_qty_3                       AS pieces,
        cm.epjp_pjpno_daily                 AS PJPNO,
        cd.pprd_prodcode                    AS prod,
        cd.pbth_batch                       AS batch,
        '@Model(prod2)'                     AS prod2,
        '@Model(batch2)'                    AS batch2,
        '@Model(reasoncode)'                AS reasoncode,
        '@Model(DateFilterOn)'              AS DateFilterOn,
        rsntypm.prnt_desc                   AS reasondesc,
        CM.MODIFIED_DATE                    AS MODIFIED_DATE
 FROM snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cm
          INNER JOIN snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                     ON cm.porg_orgacode = dt.porg_orgacode
                         AND cm.pdot_docmtype = dt.pdot_docmtype
          INNER JOIN snd_pr_dos_documentstatus ds
                     ON cm.porg_orgacode = ds.porg_orgacode
                         AND cm.pdot_docmtype = ds.pdot_docmtype
                         AND cm.pdos_docmstatus = ds.pdos_docmstatus
          INNER JOIN snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_detail cd
                     ON cd.porg_orgacode = cm.porg_orgacode
                         AND cd.pbet_busentity_type = cm.pbet_busentity_type
                         AND cd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                         AND cd.pdot_docmtype = cm.pdot_docmtype
                         AND cd.tcmm_docno = cm.tcmm_docno
          inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m lvl1m
                     ON cm.porg_orgacode = lvl1m.porg_orgacode
                         AND cm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c = lvl1m.porg_orgacode
                         AND cm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c = lvl1m.pbet_busentity_type
                         AND cm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c = lvl1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          left outer join glb_pr_rnt_reason_type_m rsntypm
                          on cd.porg_orgacode = rsntypm.porg_orgacode
                              and cd.prnt_reason_type_sale_return = rsntypm.prnt_reason_type
                              and rsntypm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

          inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt

snd_tr_gnm_gingrn_master gin
         INNER JOIN snd_pr_dot_documenttype pdot
                    ON gin.porg_orgacode = pdot.porg_orgacode
                        AND gin.pdot_docmtype = pdot.pdot_docmtype
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_dot_documenttype_m pdotm
                   ON pdot.porg_orgacode = pdotm.porg_orgacode
                       AND pdot.pdot_docmtype = pdotm.pdot_docmtype
                       AND pdotm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         INNER JOIN snd_pr_dos_documentstatus pdos
                    ON gin.porg_orgacode = pdos.porg_orgacode
                        AND gin.pdot_docmtype = pdos.pdot_docmtype
                        AND gin.pdos_docmstatus = pdos.pdos_docmstatus
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_dos_documentstatus_m pdosm
                   ON pdos.porg_orgacode = pdosm.porg_orgacode
                       AND pdos.pdot_docmtype = pdosm.pdot_docmtype
                       AND pdos.pdos_docmstatus = pdosm.pdos_docmstatus
                       AND pdosm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         INNER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1
                    ON gin.porg_orgacode = pp1.porg_orgacode
                        AND gin.pbet_busentity_type = pp1.pbet_busentity_type
                        AND gin.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1m
                   ON pp1.porg_orgacode = pp1m.porg_orgacode
                       AND pp1.pbet_busentity_type = pp1m.pbet_busentity_type
                       AND pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                       AND pp1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         INNER JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1W
                    ON gin.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b = pp1W.porg_orgacode
                        AND gin.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b = pp1W.pbet_busentity_type
                        AND gin.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b = pp1W.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1Wm
                   ON pp1W.porg_orgacode = pp1Wm.porg_orgacode
                       AND pp1W.pbet_busentity_type = pp1Wm.pbet_busentity_type
                       AND pp1W.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1Wm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                       AND pp1Wm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         INNER JOIN snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2 pp1DSR
                    ON gin.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl2_f = pp1DSR.porg_orgacode
                        AND gin.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl2_f = pp1DSR.pbet_busentity_type
                       AND gin.epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_f = pp1DSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
         LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2_m pp1DSRm
                   ON pp1DSR.porg_orgacode = pp1DSRm.porg_orgacode
                       AND pp1DSR.pbet_busentity_type = pp1DSRm.pbet_busentity_type
                       AND pp1DSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = pp1DSRm.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
                       AND pp1DSRm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_en_pjp_pjphead PJP
                   ON gin.porg_orgacode = PJP.porg_orgacode
                       AND gin.pbet_busentity_type = PJP.pbet_busentity_type
                       AND gin.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = PJP.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                       AND gin.epjp_pjpno_daily = PJP.epjp_pjpno
         LEFT JOIN snd_en_pjp_pjphead_M PJPM

                       AND PJPM.pbet_busentity_type = PJP.pbet_busentity_type
                       AND PJPM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = PJP.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                       AND PJPM.epjp_pjpno = PJP.epjp_pjpno
                       AND PJPM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

snd_tr_gnm_gingrn_detail gind
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product prd
                   ON gind.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND gind.porp_princode = prd.porp_princode
                       AND gind.pprd_prodcode = prd.pprd_prodcode
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdm
                   ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdm.porg_orgacode
                       AND prd.porp_princode = prdm.porp_princode
                       AND prd.pprd_prodcode = prdm.pprd_prodcode
                       AND prdm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdms
                   ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdms.porg_orgacode
                       AND prd.porp_princode = prdms.porp_princode
                       AND prd.pprd_prodcode = prdms.pprd_prodcode
                       AND prdms.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 CTG
                    ON CTG.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                        AND CTG.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis, Length(CTG.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                        AND CTG.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                        AND CTG.ppa1_level_no = 3
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m CTGM
                   ON CTG.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = CTGM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS AND CTG.PORG_ORGACODE = CTGM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND CTGM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 BRND
                   ON BRND.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND BRND.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis, Length(BRND.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND BRND.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND BRND.ppa1_level_no = 5
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m BRNDM
                   ON BRND.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = BRNDM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS AND BRND.PORG_ORGACODE = BRNDM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND BRNDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         INNER JOIN snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype st
                    ON gind.porg_orgacode = st.porg_orgacode
                        AND gind.pstt_stock_type = st.pstt_stock_type
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype_m stm
                   ON st.porg_orgacode = stm.porg_orgacode
                       AND st.pstt_stock_type = stm.pstt_stock_type
                       AND stm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN snd_pr_trn_trans_nature tran
                         ON gind.porg_orgacode = tran.porg_orgacode
                             AND gind.ptrn_tran_nature = tran.ptrn_tran_nature
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_trn_trans_nature_m tranm
                   ON tran.porg_orgacode = tranm.porg_orgacode
                       AND tran.ptrn_tran_nature = tranm.ptrn_tran_nature
                       AND tranm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master c1_0
         join
     (snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 b1_0
         left join
         snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m b1_1
         on b1_0.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = b1_1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
             and b1_0.pbet_busentity_type = b1_1.pbet_busentity_type
             and b1_0.porg_orgacode = b1_1.porg_orgacode
AND b1_1.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)')
     on b1_0.porg_orgacode = c1_0.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c
         and b1_0.pbet_busentity_type = c1_0.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c
         and b1_0.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = c1_0.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c
         join
     snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_refinfo c2_0
     on c2_0.porg_orgacode = c1_0.porg_orgacode
         and c2_0.pbet_busentity_type = c1_0.pbet_busentity_type
         and c2_0.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = c1_0.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         and c2_0.pdot_docmtype = c1_0.pdot_docmtype
         and c2_0.tcmm_docno = c1_0.tcmm_docno
         join
     snd_pr_dot_documenttype d1_0
     on d1_0.porg_orgacode = c2_0.porg_orgacode
         and d1_0.pdot_docmtype = c2_0.tcmr_refdoctype
         and d1_0.pdot_nature_identifier IN ('GN','GR')
         join
     snd_pr_dot_documenttype DT
     on DT.porg_orgacode = c1_0.porg_orgacode
         and DT.pdot_docmtype = c1_0.pdot_docmtype

         join
     (snd_en_pjp_pjphead PJP
         left join
         snd_en_pjp_pjphead_m PJP_M
         on PJP.porg_orgacode = PJP_M.porg_orgacode
             and PJP.pbet_busentity_type = PJP_M.pbet_busentity_type
             and PJP.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = PJP_M.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
             and PJP.epjp_pjpno = PJP_M.epjp_pjpno
AND PJP_M.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)')
     ON PJP.porg_orgacode = c1_0.porg_orgacode
         AND PJP.pbet_busentity_type = c1_0.pbet_busentity_type
         AND PJP.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = c1_0.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         AND PJP.epjp_pjpno = c1_0.epjp_pjpno_daily
LEFT JOIN SND_TR_DSN_DOC_SEQUENCE_NO DSN
                    ON DSN.PORG_ORGACODE = c1_0.PORG_ORGACODE
                     AND DSN.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = c1_0.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AND
                       DSN.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = c1_0.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE AND
                       DSN.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = CASE
when c1_0.PDOT_DOCMTYPE IN ('CM-02', 'CM-04', 'CM-07') THEN c1_0.PDOT_DOCMTYPE_REF ELSE c1_0.PDOT_DOCMTYPE END
AND DSN.TDSN_DOCNO = CASE WHEN c1_0.PDOT_DOCMTYPE IN ('CM-02', 'CM-04', 'CM-07') THEN c1_0.TCMM_REF_DOCNO ELSE c1_0.TCMM_DOCNO END
